title: 第三章 丁原还是死了
slug: 重生之战神吕布全本免费-重生之战神吕布最新章节列表
content_zh:
见陷阵营如同定海神针一般，牢牢的钉在并州军前方，让西凉军不能前进一步，吕布微微点头，眼中露出赞赏之色，陷阵营不愧陷阵之名，面对骑兵，仍旧能够占据优势。
西凉军后方的董卓见并州军稳住阵脚，己方的伤亡开始加大，急忙下令鸣金收兵。
这场战斗，并州军可算是吃了不小的亏。
“太师，如今并州军新败，防御必然松懈，何不命人夜间偷营，定然能将丁原小儿杀死。”李儒趁机献计道。
“嗯，不错，不错，那吕布受伤，乃是天赐良机，正好将并州军一并解决了。”董卓捋着胡须大笑道。
“太师，卑职愿带领五千人马斩丁原狗头。”华雄上前请战。
“好，华雄，你带领五千人马，三更时分偷袭并州军，郭汜、李傕领五千人马掩杀，牛辅领五千人马策应，若胜本太师亲自在圣上面前为你们请功。”
“诺，卑职定将丁原小儿的人头献给太师。”华雄闻言大喜，战功是武将提升地位的最快渠道。
入夜，吕布端坐营中总结今天战斗的得失，作为一名特种兵，虽然经历的都是小规模的交战，一些眼力却还是有的。
通过白天的战斗，他能看出古代战争的一些弊端，很明显的就是将领无法指挥到士卒，如果并州军都如陷阵营一般，如臂指使，今日的战斗西凉军绝对占不到任何的便宜。
突然，吕布感到一阵莫名的心悸，常年游走在生死边缘的经验告诉他有不好的事情发生。
“咚咚咚”如同闷雷一般的声音由远及近，吕布急忙拿起画戟，向外走去。
漆黑的夜晚，伸手不见五指，华雄大喊一声，率先杀入并州军中，碰到敌军也不与其颤抖，只是在大营中不停的放火。
“敌军袭营！”凄厉的喊声，整个大营顿时显得有些慌乱，许多士兵刚出帐篷就身首异处。
兵不知将，并州军乱作一团，郭汜李傕带领五千兵马从大营左侧杀出，一时间，并州军不知敌人到底有多少，慌乱之间，敌我不分，同袍之间甚至刀兵相向。
“将军速走，西凉军劫营。”张辽衣冠不整的策马冲了过来。
“狼骑何在？随我去救刺史大人。”吕布动作僵硬的爬上了战马，将手中的画戟向前一挥，带人向中军的位置赶去，不管怎么说丁原这个人还是不错的，有他在并州军能够安然无恙，如果他出了事，就麻烦了，吕布可不想还没适应这个时代，就开始流亡的生活。
“丁原已死，降者不杀！”战场中央，华雄威风凛凛的大喝道。
并州军见丁原死在了华雄手中，心生惧意，主帅都死了，打下去还有什么意义。
吕布看到华雄刀尖上的丁原人头，心中一凉，莫非穿越了也改变不了丁原的命运吗，没想到丁原没死在自己的手上，却被华雄袭营杀死。

“华雄小儿，拿命来。”吕布招呼了张辽一下，大喊一声，两人一起杀向华雄。
见吕布、张辽杀来，华雄心中一颤，当日雒阳城外，吕布的武艺他可是见识过了，一人独斗西凉军三员将领，且连战三场，其中就有他，而张辽的武艺也是不弱，这两人联合起来，自己如何是对手。
“杀。”华雄咬牙冲了上去，这个时候无论如何是不能退的。
吕布的骑术虽然不行，但战斗的本能还是有的，再加上本身的力气极大，将华雄打的只有招架之力，张辽在一旁偷袭，搞得华雄焦头烂额。
吕布的出现，无疑让慌乱的并州军找到了主心骨，没了丁原，他们还有战无不胜的吕将军。
“吕布，无耻小儿。”见并州军在各部将领的带领下站稳了阵脚，与己方军队厮杀在一起，华雄大骂一声，将丁原的头颅向吕布一扔，趁机掉马回到军中，会合郭汜兵马掩杀一阵，见吕布亲自带领骑兵和陷阵营断后，只好引兵退往雒阳。
在张辽高顺等人的帮助下，吕布收拢残兵，大军后撤在谷城附近安营扎寨。
看着被火烧的漆黑的营寨和密密麻麻的尸体，饶是经过了一场场残酷训练的吕布也有些头皮发麻，之前还是活生生的士兵，转眼就成了冰冷的尸体。
“将军，此战我军损失兵马三千余人，伤者六千余人。”张辽抱拳道。

content_en:
Seeing that the trapped camp was like a magic needle that fixed the sea, firmly nailed in front of the Bingzhou Army, preventing the Xiliang Army from moving forward. Lu Bu nodded slightly, with admiration in his eyes. The trapped camp lived up to its name, and could still have an advantage in the face of the cavalry.
Dong Zhuo, who was at the rear of the Xiliang Army, saw that the Bingzhou Army had stabilized its position and its own casualties began to increase, so he hurriedly ordered the troops to retreat.
In this battle, the Bingzhou Army suffered a big loss.
"Grand Master, now that the Bingzhou Army has been defeated, the defense must be lax. Why not order people to steal the camp at night, and they will definitely kill Ding Yuan's son." Li Ru took the opportunity to offer a plan.
"Well, that's right, that's right. That Lu Bu was injured was a God-given opportunity, and he just happened to take out the Bingzhou Army." Dong Zhuo stroked his beard and laughed.
"Grand Master, I am willing to lead five thousand men to kill Ding Yuan's head." Hua Xiong stepped forward to ask for a fight.
"Okay, Hua Xiong, you lead five thousand men and horses to sneak attack the Bingzhou army at the third watch. Guo Si and Li Jue will lead five thousand men and horses to cover up and kill them. Niu Fu will lead five thousand men and horses to respond. If you win, I will personally ask for your merits in front of the Holy Master."
"Promise, I will dedicate the head of Ding Yuan's son to the Grand Master." Hua Xiong was overjoyed when he heard this. Military exploits are the fastest way for a general to improve his status.
At night, Lu Bu sat in the camp summarizing the gains and losses of today's battle. As a special forces soldier, although he had experienced small-scale battles, he still had some discernment.
Through the battle during the day, he could see some of the shortcomings of ancient wars. It was obvious that the generals could not command the soldiers. If the Bingzhou army was trapped in a camp and could not be ordered around, the Xiliang army would definitely not take any advantage in today's battle.
Suddenly, Lu Bu felt an inexplicable palpitation in his heart. His experience of walking on the edge of life and death for many years told him that something bad had happened.
"Dong dong dong" sounded like muffled thunder from far away. Lu Bu hurriedly picked up the halberd and walked out.
In the dark night, unable to see his fingers, Hua Xiong shouted and took the lead in charging into the Bingzhou Army. He did not tremble when encountering the enemy troops, but kept setting fire to the camp.
"The enemy is attacking the camp!" screamed shrilly, and the whole camp suddenly seemed a little panicked. Many soldiers had their heads dislocated as soon as they came out of the tent.
The soldiers did not know their generals, and the Bingzhou army was in chaos. Guo Si and Li Jue led five thousand soldiers and horses to fight out from the left side of the camp. For a time, the Bingzhou army did not know how many enemies there were. In the panic, they could not distinguish between ourselves and the enemy, and even soldiers in the army were fighting each other.
"General, leave quickly. The Xiliang army has robbed the camp." Zhang Liao, disheveled, rushed over on his horse.
"Where is the Wolf Cavalry? Come with me to rescue the Governor." Lu Bu climbed onto the horse stiffly, waved the halberd in his hand forward, and led the people to the position of the central army. Anyway, Ding Yuan is a good person. With him in the Bingzhou Army, he can be safe and sound. If something happens to him, it will be in trouble. Lu Bu does not want to start a life of exile before he has adapted to this era.
"Ding Yuan is dead, and those who surrender will not be killed!" Hua Xiong shouted majestically in the center of the battlefield.
When the Bingzhou army saw Ding Yuan's death in Hua Xiong's hands, they were filled with fear. The commander was dead, so what was the point of continuing the fight.
When Lu Bu saw Ding Yuan's head on the tip of Hua Xiong's knife, he felt cold in his heart. Could it be that traveling through time could not change Ding Yuan's fate? Unexpectedly, Ding Yuan did not die in his own hands, but was killed by Hua Xiong when he attacked the camp.
"Little Hua Xiong, take your life." Lu Bu called Zhang Liao, shouted, and the two of them attacked Hua Xiong together.
Seeing Lu Bu and Zhang Liao coming to fight, Hua Xiong's heart trembled. Outside Luoyang City that day, he had seen Lu Bu's martial arts. He fought against three generals of the Xiliang Army alone, and fought three consecutive battles, including him. Zhang Liao's martial arts was not weak. If these two people joined forces, he would be his opponent.
"Kill." Hua Xiong gritted his teeth and rushed forward. At this time, he could not retreat under any circumstances.
Although Lu Bu's riding skills are not good, he still has the instinct to fight. Coupled with his great strength, Hua Xiong was only able to parry. Zhang Liao was able to fight.A sneak attack from the side made Hua Xiong miserable.
The appearance of Lu Bu undoubtedly allowed the panicked Bingzhou Army to find a backbone. Without Ding Yuan, they still had the invincible General Lu.
"Lü Bu, shameless boy." Seeing that the Bingzhou army stood firm under the leadership of the generals and fought with his own army, Hua Xiong cursed and threw Ding Yuan's head at Lu Bu. He took the opportunity to turn off his horse and return to the army. He joined Guo Si's troops to cover up the enemy for a while. Seeing that Lu Bu personally led the cavalry and broke up the enemy's camp, he had no choice but to retreat to Luoyang.
With the help of Zhang Liao, Gao Shun and others, Lu Bu gathered the remaining troops and retreated to camp near Gucheng.
Looking at the pitch-black camp that was burned by fire and the densely packed corpses, even Lu Bu, who had gone through brutal trainings, felt a little numb. The living soldiers before had turned into cold corpses in the blink of an eye.
"General, our army lost more than 3,000 soldiers and horses in this battle, and more than 6,000 were injured." Zhang Liao said, holding his fists.
